mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an easing monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that precedes economic slowdowns, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad-based economic weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO decline for two consecutive months, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-growth GDP expansion regimes (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% annualized), strong consumer spending (RSAFS) signals sustained economic momentum that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% annualized and RSAFS is above 90th percentile, or Rank IC for RSAFS in regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating price pressures that prompt monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL yoy change exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate monetary tightening coinciding with labor market weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises for two consecutive months, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In strong industrial production growth regimes (INDPRO growth rate > 1.0% monthly), robust manufacturing activity signals healthy corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO growth exceeds 1.0% monthly, or Rank IC for INDPRO in regime is below 0.03.
